about: The golden cases of section 9 of the build spec, written and hashed before the first run (eval/golden.lock.json). Cases 1 to 10 have an expected label. H1 to H3 are held out: no expected answer, written before the first run, run once, never used to tune the prompt.

document.title: Kiln airdrop terms
clauses: Hold at least 100 KILN at the Oct 1 snapshot. Wallets created after the snapshot are not eligible.
Each eligible wallet receives a share of the pool in proportion to its balance at the snapshot.
The claim opens on Oct 15 and closes on Dec 15. Unclaimed tokens return to the treasury.
Claimed tokens vest linearly over 12 months, with 25% available at the time of claim. Unvested tokens cannot be transferred.
Claiming requires a wallet that has passed the verification step described in the claim portal.
Kiln may change or end the program at any time without notice.

cases.title: Same meaning, different wording
cases.claim: You need 100 KILN at the Oct 1 snapshot

cases.title: A deadline the clause does not have
cases.claim: You need 100 KILN at any time before Oct 31

cases.title: Overstates a partial unlock
cases.claim: Tokens are fully unlocked at claim

cases.title: A fair shorthand of a vesting clause
cases.claim: A quarter at claim, the rest over a year

cases.title: Drops a condition: with notice instead of without notice
cases.claim: Kiln may change the program, with notice

cases.title: A shorter claim that keeps the point
cases.claim: Kiln can change the program at any time

cases.title: The clause is silent on fees

cases.title: Not in the clause
cases.claim: Every eligible wallet gets the same amount
